name: ROPCA
description: ROPCA (Robotic Platform for Clinical Automation) is a Danish medical technology company founded in 2019 in Odense as a spin-off from the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) and Odense University Hospital. ROPCA develops the [ARTHUR](/robot/ropca_arthur) automated robotic ultrasound platform (built on the [KUKA LBR Med](/robot/kuka_lbr_med) arm) for clinical diagnostics in rheumatoid arthritis.
